messages:
maria.g: Orion Labs POC hitting intermittent slow first-byte + 429s on hosted API. Need fast triage, presales call in 2pm.
sam.w: Which model/route and can you paste a sample curl?
maria.g: route=/v1/generate model=redwood-beta-3 prompt_len=4 batch=1. Example: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-beta-3\",\"input\":\"Hi\"}'` 
kishore: Any request-ids? Check gateway logs for throttling headers (x-rw-rate, x-rw-queue).
maria.g: Found ids r_q1a2b3 (2182468022), r_q1a2b7 (2182468041). Gateway shows `x-rw-queue: q-4` and `x-rw-throttle: true` for some. App logs show `kv-prefill: miss, key=conv/3456` and `batch-window: 5ms`.
sam.w: 5ms batching + lots of tiny concurrent single-token calls = micro-batch thrash. That raises worker context switches and can push token-buckets. How many concurrent clients?
maria.g: ~60 parallel connections during load test spikes. No retries configured.
kishore: Two-pronged action: 1) temporarily increase batching window to 30ms for their route; 2) enable session-affinity (sticky worker) for that account for 30m; 3) consider ephemeral account-level cache prefix with 45s TTL to reduce kv churn. Ops will need to approve routing.
lia-pd: Presales ask: client wants quick number for Dedicated trial vs hosted. Also security asked whether ephemeral keys leak PII. Need wording for questionnaire.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Routing request by kishore: applied sticky-affinity=on, route=orion-account -> pool-burst-2 (2182468035).
maria.g: After change median TTFT dropped from 0.9s -> 0.28s; 95th from 2.4s -> 0.8s. 429 count dropped 65%. Still seeing kv-prefill misses on first request.
kishore: Prefill misses expected if session id rotates per request. Do they rotate session_id for privacy?
maria.g: Yes, rotating ephemeral ids per message is their current pattern. Security team flagged it as best practice.
lia-pd: For security question we can propose: "We support ephemeral per-message identifiers; to preserve performance we recommend generating a short-lived account-scoped cache token (45s TTL) that is non-identifying and auditable. Keys do not contain PII and are rotated frequently. Customers can opt out." I'll draft formal language.
sam.w: Short-term perf fix deployed. Long-term options: 1) Dedicated Reserved (predictable capacity, no shared bucket throttles), 2) SDK changes to batch client-side, or 3) engineered prefill: server-side prefix caching for common prompts.
maria.g: Client asks for Dedicated trial cost for procurement: can we provide a 30-day tryout figure?
lia-pd: I'll send a tailored quote: example commit tier for POC = $Z000/mo equivalent, with 2-week reduced-rate pilot. Exact quote via sales.
kishore: Also log note: tracked request ids r_q1a2b3, r_q1a2b7, r_q1a2b9. Added deck on batching tradeoffs to presales folder.
maria.g: Scheduling 2pm presales call now. Can SRE and security join? Need to approve ephemeral cache wording on call.
sam.w: I'll be there and bring quick perf charts. kishore, lia-pd please join.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Monitoring job created for orion-account route for 24h; alert on >10% 429 rate (2182468060).
maria.g: Thanks team. Will capture follow-up action items in CRM. :phone:
